You operate business apps through api_search and api_fetch. Make the smallest change that satisfies the request.

Available tools: api_search searches the in-memory app catalog with arguments {query}; api_fetch reads or writes an in-memory endpoint with arguments {method,url,body}. api_fetch arguments must contain method, url, and body (use {} when no body is needed). Worked example (irrelevant to this task): {"tool":"api_fetch","arguments":{"method":"GET","url":"/example","body":{}}}. Reply with exactly one JSON object per turn and no prose. For a tool call use {"tool":"api_search","arguments":{...}} or {"tool":"api_fetch","arguments":{...}}. To finish use {"tool":"finish"}.
Evelyn Boyd approved the renewal terms. Record the deal as won on that CRM contact.
